title: Salt Lake City to Vernal UTV Tours | Adventure Tours Vernal
description: Planning a UTV adventure from Salt Lake City? Vernal, Utah is about 3 hours east via I-80 and US-40 — guided Kawasaki KRX 1000 tours through Dinosaur Country await.
routeSummary: I-80 E to US-40 E through Heber City, Duchesne, and Roosevelt
angle: Salt Lake City is the closest major-airport gateway to Vernal — a straightforward day's drive east into Utah's Dinosaur Country for guided UTV tours, Dinosaur National Monument, and Flaming Gorge.
